sunday 9th for elijah, the lord was not the mighty wind but the gentle breeze. peter’s faith fails in the face
of the wind and the sea. ‘lord! save me’ is a prayer for all in times of fear and opposition.
monday 10th st lawrence, deacon, one of the most venerated saints of the church of rome. remembered for
his generosity to the poor and for his faithfulness as a martyr.
tuesday 1th st clare (1193-1253). born in assisi, she followed st francis in his life of poverty and founded
wednesday 12th st jane frances de chantal (1572-1641) at the age of twenty married baron de chantal
but after nine years was left a widow with four children. her friendship with st francis de sales led to the
foundation of the congregation of the visitation.
st lelia, who is said to have been baptized by st patrick.
thursday 13th st pontian and st hippolytus, martyrs. pontian became bishop of rome in 230; hippolytus
was a roman priest and a learned and influential theologian. both were exiled to the mines of sardinia at a
time of persecution.
friday 14th st maximilian kolbe (1894-1941), a franciscan who worked in the apostolate of the press in
poland and japan. he returned to poland in 1936 but was later arrested by the nazis and sent to auschwitz.
there he offered to take the place of a married man with a family who had been sentenced to death. he died
in auschwitz on 14th august 1941.
vigil mass of the assumption in ballybrack at 7.30pm.
saturday 15th the assumption of the blessed virgin mary. at the end of her life mary was glorified by
god in body and soul, conformed completely to the risen christ. today’s feast celebrates her blessed state in
all its fullness. holyday of obligation. mass in st pius x at 10am and vigil for sunday at 7.00pm.
sunday 16th 11.30am mass will be celebrated in ballybrack.
mass this week in st pius x: monday to friday 10am. saturday 6.30pm; sunday 10am. confessions in st.
pius x church : saturday 5.45pm to 6.15pm. the rosary and the divine mercy chaplet will be recited in
st. pius x church, moville, at 7.30 pm every day, from sunday – friday. adoration of the blessed
sacrament on monday, 2-9pm; wednesday, 6-9pm.
thank you for your generous financial support to the parish in the past week, which amounted to €3425.

sunday 2nd like the manna in the desert, bread in plenty for the crowds is seen as a sign of
the coming of the kingdom and the heavenly banquet at the end of time. the actions of jesus
in the desert are described in the same way as his actions at the last supper; he takes, blesses,
tuesday 4th st john vianney (1786-1859) had to contend with poverty, military service and
his own intellectual shortcomings in order to become a priest. in 1817 he was sent to care for
the people of ars, a small french village. the marvellous gift of his seeing into the depths of
the soul brought the world to ars. from 1830 the curé averaged twelve to sixteen hours in the
confessional. patron of priests.
wednesday 5th dedication of the basilica of st mary major. in 431 the council of ephesus
declared that mary was the mother of god. very shortly after, this church was dedicated in
rome with the title of st mary, the first such church in the west.
first anniversary mass for john white at 10am.
thursday 6th the transfiguration . the cross requires the exodus of jesus, his death,
resurrection and glorification. the disciples have to realise that he must depart just as they
are now prepared for his going to jerusalem to die.
friday 7th st sixtus ii and his four deacons companions were put to death in 258.
blessing of the fleet at 4pm in greencastle.
saturday 8th st dominic (1170-1221) a spaniard who founded the order of preachers
(dominicans) to counteract the albigensian heresy
